en: Sepia-toned aerial photograph of a large mosque complex with an inner courtyard and a tall square minaret rising above surrounding low-rise traditional buildings. The view shows the dense urban fabric of the old city around the mosque. Captions in French, English, and Arabic are printed beneath the image, identifying it as a view of the great mosque of Marrakech taken from an airplane.
